text: This report summarizes the discussions at the Tenant Liaison Consultation meeting held in person on December 6, 2023 in the Enercare Centre, StudioEx. Leading the meeting were Don Boyle - Chief Executive Officer, Kelvin Seow - Chief People and Strategy Officer, and co-hosted by Mr. Howard Lichtman Member of the Board of Governors. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Laura Purdy - General Manager, Tony Porter - Director, Security and Transportation, Lynn Essensa - Labour Relations Consultant, and Catherine de Nobriga, Tenant and Community Relations Coordinator. Twenty (20) tenant representatives were in attendance.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (April 11, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
